entities.summary: Roberts Štelmahers is a Latvian professional basketball coach and former player who played the point guard position. He was most recently the head coach for Czarni Słupsk of the Polish Basketball League (PLK). Štelmahers was a member of the Latvia national basketball team from 1992 to 2005 participating in four EuroBasket final tournaments in 1997, 2001, 2003 and 2005. He has played a total of 144 games for his national team.
